summary: The catch-up writer test counts the page each writer hold covers (batches sealed, envelopes received and admitted, claims projected, repairs applied) instead of timing the holds; smallclaims' paged paths report what each hold covered to a test's holds_during scope

schema.detail: No table, file or schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or digest change.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or CLI change. smallclaims::windows::holds gains holds_during, Holds and covered; longest_during returns what it did. Outside a holds_during scope, which only tests open, covered is one thread-local read.
